The fundamental periods estimated for the `r uniqueN(DynamicsSummary$periods$IDg)` slope geometries of the project (heights of `r min(DynamicsSummary$periods$Hs)` to `r max(DynamicsSummary$periods$Hs)` m and slope angles of `r .fmt(min(DynamicsSummary$periods$beta), 0)` to `r .fmt(max(DynamicsSummary$periods$beta), 0)`°) and for the `r unique(DynamicsSummary$periods$nIDm)` material classes range from `r .fmt(min(DynamicsSummary$periods$Ts.min), 2)` s for the lowest and stiffest slopes to `r .fmt(max(DynamicsSummary$periods$Ts.max), 2)` s for the highest slopes, with a median of `r .fmt(median(DynamicsSummary$periods$Ts.med), 2)` s across the geometries. The period increases systematically with embankment height, from a representative value of `r .fmt(DynamicsSummary$periods[Hs == min(Hs), Ts.med], 2)` s for the `r min(DynamicsSummary$periods$Hs)` m slope to `r .fmt(DynamicsSummary$periods[Hs == max(Hs), Ts.med], 2)` s for the `r max(DynamicsSummary$periods$Hs)` m slope. The base stiffness governing these periods, expressed as the small-strain shear modulus, ranges from `r .fmt(min(DynamicsSummary$periods$Go.min), 0)` to `r .fmt(max(DynamicsSummary$periods$Go.max), 0)` MPa, equivalent to shear-wave velocities of `r .fmt(min(DynamicsSummary$periods$VSo.min), 0)` to `r .fmt(max(DynamicsSummary$periods$VSo.max), 0)` m/s, depending on the material class and the stress state at the base.
